producer: FN3-03 (#49) owns fixtures/ and the pinned fixture revision
note: This is the only file CI reads to decide which model fixtures a run uses. status must be 'pinned', revision must be a 40-hex commit, and fixtures_manifest_sha256 must match the manifest bytes before the pinned-model lane runs. While status is 'unpinned' the lane reports NOT VERIFIED naming this file and FN3-03 (#49); it never silently passes. Run 'python3 tools/ci/model_pin.py seal' after FN3-03 publishes fixtures/ to fill the hash.
